plugins.description: Fail-fast spec-driven development. Three gates (classify, contract pre-flight, red test) and two blast-radius axes route each change to the cheapest safe path. Includes /hsi (start here), /hsi-setup, /hsi-change, /hsi-finish, /hsi-trim and /hsi-audit.
